research_question: Does one-shot recycle-boundary state improve native ContextBench selection while avoiding repeated state input and recycle amplification?
stop_conditions: Any missing or duplicate recycled-generation presentation, state above 1,024 tokens, more than four fitting measurements, unmatched receipt, false fact, or omitted token is an instrument failure.
Any second incomplete output or correction count above one is an instrument failure.
No acceptance or successor selection change from observed outcomes.
No within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, policy, or ordering change and no lucky rerun.
Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure and retain every attempted outcome.

success_criteria.scope: Eight exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K one-shot boundary-state pairs; no full cohort, larger window, confirmation, repair correctness, transfer, or clearance claim.
